يتبحبحن (form IIq)
# يَتَبَحْبَحْنَ (yatabaḥbaḥna) /ja.ta.baħ.baħ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# يُتَبَحْبَحْنَ (yutabaḥbaḥna) /ju.ta.baħ.baħ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
